name: je-crypto-tax
description: Jersey cryptocurrency tax classification checked in October 2026, covering mining, exchanges, business receipts, sterling valuation and GST treatment. Use for Jersey Bitcoin tax, crypto disposals, mining income, crypto payments or reporting-provider obligations. Applies the published trading distinction before treating a disposal as taxable or non-taxable and separates tax liability from the Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework. Includes a bounded GST valuation example for an established standard-rated sale. Staking, decentralised finance, tokens, international reporting and regulatory status need further evidence. This source-cited draft awaits professional review and does not classify every cryptocurrency transaction from its label.
